title: Decompose monolithic JS in commission-forecaster (tracer bullet)
description:
Each tool has 300-450 lines in a single IIFE. Start with commission-forecaster (worst offender: 100+ variable declarations in one scope).

Refactor into single-responsibility functions:
- setupInputs() — bind range sliders → display
- validate(inputs) — return { valid, errors }
- calculate(inputs) — pure function, no DOM
- renderResults(results) — side-effect: update DOM
- animateCounters(data) — trigger toolAnimateValue
- runProcessing(cb) — animated progress then cb
- wireEvents() — bind all listeners in one pass

Done when:
- commission-forecaster JS is decomposed into named SRP functions
- calculate() is a pure function (same inputs → same outputs, no DOM)
- No regressions in tool behavior
- Repeatable pattern documented for other 12 tools
